payload.title: ADR 0013: Drafting provider per workspace
payload.context: M5 (#5): OpenAI becomes a second drafting provider next to Anthropic, selectable per workspace through PrismDraftGenerator.
payload.rationale: The choice is a nullable column on workspaces; null follows the instance default. The operator opts in to offering a provider with NOONGUN_DRAFT_PROVIDERS. Keys are bound to their provider in code, so a key for one vendor can never be sent to the other. A choice that is no longer offered stops drafting instead of falling back, because the brief would go to a vendor the workspace did not choose. Caps ignore the provider, so switching opens no new allowance.
alternatives: Fall back to the default provider when the choice is not offered
payload.consequences: Input tokens now include cached input, with optional cache prices. OpenAI requests send store false. Provider HTTP answers are read through ProviderReplies to classify 429 and to count cut-off answers.
